title: Zesty Agave American Lavender Tagine
description: A fragrant, floral tagine starring lavender and agave leaf, perfect for a solo American dinner that balances zing and sweetness.

ingredients.name: agave leaf (vessel)
ingredients.notes: rinsed and de-sprouted to create a cavity

instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and trim the agave leaf, rinsing thoroughly and cutting off the outer layer to create a cavity.
Drizzle 1 tbsp of olive oil inside the leaf and roast the leaf for 5 minutes to warm the cavity.
In a skillet, heat the remaining 1 tbsp olive oil over medium heat and sauté onion and garlic until translucent.
Add carrot, sweet potato, chickpeas, cumin, smoked paprika, and a pinch of salt, cooking for 5 minutes while stirring.
Transfer the vegetable mixture into the warm agave leaf, then pour white wine vinegar and coconut milk evenly over the contents.
Tightly fold the edges of the leaf, securing it with a kitchen string or a small foil tent to keep moisture in.
Bake the packed leaf in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, checking once for liquid evaporation and adding a splash of water if it dries out.
Remove from oven, let it rest for 5 minutes, then carefully unwrap the leaf, sprinkle fresh lavender buds, and serve hot.
